title: Restore a cloud link to the state its link matrix defines: identity by cloud GUID, move back un-shared links and report their Shared Site, never move a shared link, no dialogs
use_when: A repair run must bring every link of a host back to the link matrix: found by cloud identity, at the shared position, associated with the shared site, pinned, on its workset
A link was moved, rotated, unloaded, removed, duplicated or put on another workset
The run is unattended (batch over many hosts) and must not stop on a dialog
not_for: Models that do not share one coordinate system: set coordinates first (ARPL-LNK-0001)
Local file links (identity there comes from the file path)
Links placed origin to origin on purpose

environment.tool: RevitBridge MCP with run_csharp (agent-driven tests calling the add-in's repair engine)
environment.batch_tool: ZEN 1.2.1 test builds (Repair Links, ACC Gate)
environment.model: Snowdon Towers sample federation, 6 ACC cloud models, Architecture host with 5 links

changelog.change: First recorded from the ZEN 1.2.1 Repair Links tests (IN-0033)
v06: batch retest with all worksets open passes (3 hosts, rerun clean)

v07: root cause of the shared-site binding (IN-0035). FP69 corrected (history kept); rule 3 changed: never move a bound link; re-create only an unbound instance with nothing attached, otherwise keep it, put it in place and report the unresolved binding; file links can be bound in place by PublishCoordinates. New FP72-FP74.

v08: owner rule - existing links are never re-created for their Shared Site; un-shared links are moved back, pinned and reported for a manual Shared Site; shared links are never moved; saveable-positions guard. Tested on an ACC host (not synced) and a local copy.
